scope: builder and equilibrium review skill contracts

decision_question: What maturity and release decision is justified by the current repository evidence without treating documentation, smoke tests, or reviewer agreement as proof of user outcome?
acceptance_criteria: Material claims distinguish evidence classes and unknowns
The private creator is usable with explicit limits
ReFolDec executable capability and public readiness are evidenced before graduation
Public boundary and platform-fact maintenance are reviewable
Release decisions disclose correlated context and missing holdout evidence

claim_ledger.claim: FoundRy is the private governance relay and ReFolDec is a hosted capability.
claim_ledger.consequence: Identity or visibility may be misrepresented.
claim_ledger.next_test: Review a generated package for identity leakage.

claim_ledger.claim: FoundRy documents relay hierarchy, child responsibilities, naming rules, and required files.
ReFolDec defines fold, unfold, refold, and a maturity vocabulary.
claim_ledger.next_test: Process one fixture through each operation.

claim_ledger.claim: The ReFolDec schema constrains a minimum artifact envelope.
claim_ledger.next_test: Add required-field, provenance, and boundary fixtures.

claim_ledger.claim: ReFolDec has an executable capture, validation, and transformation pipeline.
claim_ledger.consequence: Public graduation could ship a concept rather than a capability.

claim_ledger.claim: The creator is browser-only, localStorage-backed, and supports manual Markdown export.
claim_ledger.consequence: Users may expect durable or collaborative storage.

claim_ledger.claim: The private creator is usable for one project with explicit browser-local limits.
claim_ledger.consequence: Users may lose work or misunderstand completion.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run an unseen representative builder task.

claim_ledger.claim: The dedicated creator reuses canonical pages, but proxy route behavior is not fully proven.
claim_ledger.consequence: Documented routes may fail or diverge in preview.
claim_ledger.next_test: Exercise every documented route through the proxy.

claim_ledger.claim: Governance controls define a private/public boundary and prohibit automatic sensitive-material graduation.
Platform-comparison checks detect stale, malformed, undated, or unsafe fact entries.
claim_ledger.next_test: Verify one current official source end-to-end.

claim_ledger.claim: Current OpenAI Builder limits and publication requirements are verified for this baseline.
claim_ledger.next_test: Capture dated official citations for volatile claims.

claim_ledger.claim: Repository checks and reviewer agreement demonstrate reliable user outcomes.
claim_ledger.consequence: Implementation confidence may be mistaken for maturity.
claim_ledger.next_test: Run a protected unseen behavioral holdout.

shared_model_or_source_limits: All five passes are analytical role simulations over one repository context and frozen source set.
No external agent execution, specialist reviewer, production telemetry, or unseen behavioral holdout was used.
Agreement is correlated evidence and is not treated as independent proof.

initial_reviews.judgment: confirmed documented boundaries and local implementation evidence; blocked unsupported capability and platform claims
creator usable with limits; ReFolDec user outcome unproven
private boundary is explicit; portability, leakage, and local-state risks remain
approve private relay, approve creator with limits, defer public ReFolDec

falsification_hypotheses: fresh-browser or project-context changes can cause loss or ambiguity
export can appear complete while required phases are incomplete
private-source material can leak into a public package
platform facts can drift while remaining syntactically valid
schema-valid ReFolDec objects can be mistaken for validated transformations

decisive_evidence: FoundRy identity and boundary are explicitly documented
creator typecheck and selected smoke tests pass
ReFolDec pipeline, holdout, and current platform source evidence are missing
unresolved_items: governance enforcement at public artifact boundaries

limitations: No live agent execution or unseen holdout has been recorded.
No current official OpenAI Builder documentation was retrieved for this baseline.
Local validation does not prove user outcomes, security, accessibility, or public readiness.

follow_up.decisive_test: Validate positive, invalid, stale, private-source, and public-safe fixtures.
follow_up.release_consequence: ReFolDec cannot claim validated or canonical maturity; public graduation blocked.

follow_up.decisive_test: Run one raw-to-structured-to-refolded fixture with expected outputs and failures.
Verify deterministic outcomes for incomplete and complete fixtures.
follow_up.dependency: Creator acceptance criteria and artifact validation

follow_up.decisive_test: Audit identity, visibility, provenance, and public-boundary violations.
Run a protected task set not used to design the workflow.
follow_up.release_consequence: No outcome, reliability, or uplift claim.

refresh_trigger: Refresh on material mitigation, platform change, public artifact proposal, or by 2026-11-22.
